notes: The CSU GE Breadth Certificate of Achievement section (Control Number 18117) prints only: 'Unit Range for Completion : 39.0 - 39.0', 'Complete all CSU General Education Breadth Requirements (Plan B) to a minimum of 39 units.', and a program rule header '(Total Units 39.0 - 39.0) The following number of Units' with no courses listed beneath it. No blocks were recorded.

The Area 5A/5B/5C/6 course lists at the top of page 102 sit before the CSU GE heading and end with 'Control Number: 45619'; in this catalog the control number closes each program, so those lists belong to the preceding program (its Area 1-6 numbering suggests Cal-GETC), not to this award.

The certificate is itself the CSU GE Breadth pattern; ge_pattern names it and total_units records the printed 39 units. ge_units left null since no separate GE figure is printed apart from the award total.
No program learning outcomes or careers are printed for this award.

Part 2: The section for this award (Control Number 18117) prints only: 'Unit Range for Completion : 39.0 - 39.0', 'Complete all CSU General Education Breadth Requirements (Plan B) to a minimum of 39 units.', and a Program Rules header '(Total Units 39.0 - 39.0) The following number of Units' with no courses beneath it. The single block is recorded from that header with an empty course list.

Part 2: The Area 5A/5B/5C and Area 6 Ethnic Studies lists above it on page 102 end with Control Number 45619 and appear to belong to the preceding program (likely a Cal-GETC certificate), not this award; they were not read into this record.

Part 2: ge_pattern is set to the CSU GE Breadth pattern because the award itself is completion of that pattern; ge_units left null since 39 is recorded as the certificate's total_units. Reviewer may prefer ge_pattern null for a certificate.
